# Independent MIDI 1.0 wire vectors. Numbers before | are public field values.
# MIDI 1.0 Detailed Specification 4.2.1: Channel Voice, System Common,
# System Real-Time, System Exclusive; summary table 1 for F1 bit layout.
# Program/channel offsets and signed bend are meedee's public conventions.
# SysEx arguments are hexadecimal payload bytes, excluding F0/F7.
NoteOn 1 60 100 | 90 3c 64
NoteOn 16 127 0 | 9f 7f 00
NoteOn 1 0 127 | 90 00 7f
NoteOff 1 60 64 | 80 3c 40
NoteOff 16 127 127 | 8f 7f 7f
PolyPressure 1 60 50 | a0 3c 32
PolyPressure 16 0 127 | af 00 7f
ControlChange 1 0 0 | b0 00 00
ControlChange 16 7 100 | bf 07 64
ControlChange 1 64 127 | b0 40 7f
ControlChange 1 120 0 | b0 78 00
ControlChange 16 127 127 | bf 7f 7f
ProgramChange 1 1 | c0 00
ProgramChange 16 128 | cf 7f
ChannelPressure 1 0 | d0 00
ChannelPressure 16 127 | df 7f
PitchBend 1 -8192 | e0 00 00
PitchBend 16 -1 | ef 7f 3f
PitchBend 1 0 | e0 00 40
PitchBend 1 1 | e0 01 40
PitchBend 16 8191 | ef 7f 7f
QuarterFrame 0 0 | f1 00
QuarterFrame 7 15 | f1 7f
SongPosition 0 | f2 00 00
SongPosition 128 | f2 00 01
SongPosition 16383 | f2 7f 7f
SongSelect 0 | f3 00
SongSelect 127 | f3 7f
TuneRequest | f6
TimingClock | f8
Start | fa
Continue | fb
Stop | fc
ActiveSensing | fe
SystemReset | ff
SysEx | f0 f7
SysEx 7d 00 7f | f0 7d 00 7f f7
